desc_en: A refined silhouette that redefines casual elegance. The quarter-zip design brings modern versatility to this wardrobe staple. Crafted from soft heritage cotton to deliver exceptional comfort and an impeccable drape. Deep dark tones project a confident and sophisticated presence. Each piece is meticulously crafted to order in our facilities. We offer worldwide shipping for your convenience. A purified expression of contemporary luxury for those who demand distinction in every detail.
